environment.description: Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards POST requests from /api/v2/documents/process to the Flask API container, which enqueues tasks to Redis broker. ALB listener on port 443 uses standard TLS termination with server certificate only. No authentication layer between public internet and the API. SCHEMA_REGISTRY config contains only 'invoice', 'receipt', and 'contract' document types.
